A bright shallow tropical BAY seen from the shore at a low angle, pale cream sand curving toward clear turquoise ocean, broad pink-purple coral reef silhouettes visible through the near water, distant blue rock islets, warm cream sky. Cheerful light fantasy anime scene, more marine and coral-colored than a freshwater green pond. Readable at 240px, wide16:9. No fish, characters, UI or text, no moon or night.

jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE polished Japanese anime game fishing rod icon, genuinely transparent background, square canvas, full object with 12% margin. A simple curved blue-and-ivory rod angled diagonally lower-left to upper-right with a small warm-gold reel and a short pale-blue line ending in a tiny star-shaped bobber beside it. Crisp indigo outline, large cel-shaded forms, readable at64px. No hand, person, fish, scene, water, text, UI, frame or loose particles. Not realistic, not3D; one rod only.
